newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech c.bank sets one-week "sell and buy" tender.
newsitem.headline: Czech c.bank sets one-week "sell and buy" tender.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) on Monday said it would hold a one-week "sell and buy" tender with no limit rate.
CNB officials were not immediately available for comment on the operation, but local money market dealers said it was similar to a reverse repo tender, but was not to drain market liquidity.

Instead, they said, it was most likely being used to provide the Finance Ministry with funds to help it overcome current cash problems which have caused the government to delay by several days the payment of some public sector wages.
The ministry has been strapped for cash in recent days due to what it says are problems in Czech legislation which limit its short-term borrowing capabilities to 16 billion crowns.
The local daily Malda Fronta Dnes reported on Monday that Finance Minister Ivan Pilip was prepared to borrow from the CNB beyond the limit to meet government payment commitments.
Finance ministry officials were not immediately available for comment.
